title: The Best Fix for a Biased Model Didn't Touch the Model
question: The Best Fix for a Biased Model Didn't Touch the Model
hook: Three teams fix the same biased AI — one rewrites the loss, one rebuilds the data, and the one that never touches the model wins by an order of magnitude.
core_idea: Bias flows from protected attribute to outcome along multiple causal paths, and an intervention only removes what its path carries — leverage is which paths you block, and the highest-leverage path often bypasses the model entirely.
visual_object: a causal path diagram from world to decision with bias flowing through it; interventions as dams on individual paths
prerequisites: what a deployed ML pipeline is
exclusions: no do-calculus notation, no ten-mechanism taxonomy, no fairness metrics; keep the parable labeled as constructed (the book flags it); effect sizes stay qualitative — the book's magnitudes are illustrative
